summary: Verified the index.css @layer components fix for the production-build-only styling bug. Ran a real `yarn build` (success, 18s) and served build/ via `npx serve -s build -l 4173`, then visually + computed-style verified the Entrepreneurship Workshop bottom CTA in that PRODUCTION build: card bg = rgb(91,33,182) solid purple, heading rgb(255,255,255), paragraph rgba(255,255,255,0.85), PiggyBank icon rgb(255,210,63), pill button bg rgb(255,210,63) / text rgb(29,53,87) (data-testid=ew-cta-book-trial-btn). Bug is FIXED. Also confirmed compiled CSS ordering: .card-playful{ @6065 and .btn-primary{ @6485 now precede .bg-\[\#5B21B6\]{ @35165. Regression checks in prod build (LandingPage bg-[#F3E8FF]/bg-[#FFF9E8]/bg-[#E0FBFC] cards, FinancialLiteracy CTA bg-[#E0FBFC], btn-primary yellow) and in the DEV preview (EW CTA + ew-track-detail, landing cards, authenticated child dashboard account gradient cards, /wallet gradient cards, /savings-goals bg-[#06D6A0]/10, /store 44 btn-primary buttons) all render identically with no visual regression.
critical_code_review_comments: Side effect of moving classes into @layer components: Tailwind now PURGES any of these classes not found in ./src content. Verified purged-and-unused: .btn-accent, .panel-cyan, .input-playful, .account-spending/savings/investing/giving, .progress-bar, .progress-fill, .nav-item-active (zero references in src/**/*.jsx|js, so harmless today). If any of these are reintroduced via a dynamically composed className string (e.g. `btn-${variant}` or class names built in a DB/CMS field), Tailwind's scanner will not see them and they will silently vanish in production builds. Recommend either adding them to tailwind safelist or always using full literal class names.
index.css now has two separate @layer components blocks (lines ~107-220 and ~473-496) plus unlayered rules in between; consider consolidating into one block for maintainability.

.card-playful[class*="bg-gradient"] { background-color: transparent } is a brittle attribute-substring hack that only works for the gradient case; a same-specificity bg-[#hex] utility now wins only because of the layer ordering. Fine as-is, but note that any future plain-CSS rule appended after @tailwind utilities without a @layer wrapper will reintroduce this exact class of bug.

context_for_next_testing_agent: To reproduce prod-only CSS bugs: cd /app/frontend && yarn build, then `npx --yes serve -s build -l 4173 &` and point Playwright at http://localhost:4173. NOTE: authenticated flows CANNOT be tested on that origin - backend CORS rejects http://localhost:4173 (both /api/auth/login and /api/auth/school-login fail with a CORS preflight error), so do authenticated regression checks on the dev preview URL instead. Remember to `pkill -f 'serve -s build'` after. The /app/frontend/build folder is left in the repo from this run.
rca_of_the_issue: Confirmed the main agent's RCA. Plain CSS rules placed after `@tailwind utilities;` in index.css were emitted after the generated utilities in the concatenated production stylesheet; with equal specificity (single class), .card-playful{background-color:white} won the cascade tie over .bg-[#5B21B6]. Dev server injects CSS chunks separately, hiding it. Wrapping those rules in @layer components makes PostCSS/Tailwind hoist them into the components layer (before utilities), so utilities now win. Verified by byte-offset comparison in the compiled CSS and by live computed styles on a served production build.
